title: The clams, eaten
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Wednesday. The grease sack on the step, from Gully, the third day of it. This time the door opens. A hand takes the sack. The sack, later, empty on the step. The first thing eaten since.

panels.composition: The garage step. A grease sack. GULLY's back going down the alley.
props: a grease sack on the step

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a paper grease sack on a garage step with a stocky man's back walking away down an alley, no words

panels.composition: The door opening six inches. A hand. The sack going in.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a garage door open six inches with a man's hand reaching out to take a paper sack from the step, no words

panels.composition: The step, empty. The door closed. Rain.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, an empty garage step with the door closed in rain, no words

panels.composition: Later. The sack, on the step again, folded flat, empty. Gully's back coming up the alley to find it. Stopping when he sees.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a stocky man stopping in an alley at the sight of a paper sack folded flat and empty on a garage step, no words
